project.name: Largoward
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 3 of 8. Strict settlement merit, See, café-led Eat, all named trail providers, picnic, public visitor parking, public toilets, access, transport, dogs and complete local HES/NRHE construction dates were checked before continuing. Proposed community space, paths and café are not treated as existing. Bowbridge Alpacas and surrounding businesses are outside the strict village boundary.
